name: Classroom A
description: The starting abandoned classroom where student spirit Sothea lingers.
guideTitle: CLASSROOM A PURIFIED: SPIRIT OF SOTHEA
guideNarrative: By solving the ancient questions, the restless student spirit Sothea has found peace. A key has materialized on the classroom floor! Take it and make your way to the Teachers' Lounge.
guideNextStep:
• Pick up the Teachers' Lounge Key from the floor!
• Unlock the classroom door and step out into the Central Main Hall.
• Head across to the Teachers' Lounge (East Wing, Lower-Mid) and press [E] to unlock.

name: Teachers' Lounge
description: Faculty break room where staff records and emergency tools were stored.
guideNarrative: The faculty attendance ledger reveals the teachers' desperate attempt to seal the evil before darkness took over. A new key has materialized on the lounge floor!
guideNextStep:
• Pick up the Music & Art Key from the floor!
• Return to the Central Main Hall.
• Head across to the Music & Art Studio (West Wing, Bottom) and press [E] to unlock.

name: Music & Art Room
description: Creative arts studio with a grand piano, easels, and forgotten melodies.
guideTitle: MUSIC & ART STUDIO PURIFIED: HAUNTED HARMONY
guideNarrative: The haunted grand piano echoes a final peaceful melody. The spirits of the choir depart peacefully. A new key has materialized near the easels!
guideNextStep:
• Pick up the Restroom Key from the floor!
• Return to the Central Main Hall.
• Head to the Restroom & Haunted Mirror (East Wing, Bottom) and press [E] to unlock.

name: Restroom / Washroom
description: Haunted washroom with shattered mirrors and eerie plumbing echoes.
guideNarrative: The dark stains across the cracked mirror dissolve into crystal water. The mirror phantom bows in gratitude and vanishes. A new key has materialized on the floor!
guideNextStep:
• Pick up the School Infirmary Key from the floor!
• Return to the Central Main Hall.
• Head up to the School Infirmary (East Wing, Top) and press [E] to unlock.

name: School Infirmary
description: Medical clinic ward where healing medicines and bandages are kept.
guideNarrative: The gentle spirit of the school nurse blesses you with restorative energy. Darkness lifts from the medical ward. A new key has materialized on the clinic floor!
guideNextStep:
• Pick up the Storage Vault Key from the floor!
• Return to the Central Main Hall.
• Head down to the Storage Vault (East Wing, Upper-Mid) and press [E] to unlock.

name: Storage Vault
description: Heavy security storage chamber holding maintenance tools and night gear.
guideNarrative: The heavy iron vault chains shatter as the malevolent spirits disperse. A key has materialized on the stone floor among the supply crates!
guideNextStep:
• Pick up the Science Lab Key from the floor!
• Return to the Central Main Hall.
• Cross over to the Science Lab (West Wing, Upper-Mid) and press [E] to unlock.

name: Science Lab
description: Alchemy and chemistry laboratory with bubbling spirit distillers.
guideNarrative: The alchemical distillers glow with calming emerald light as toxic fumes dissipate. A key has materialized next to the lab experiment counter!
guideNextStep:
• Pick up the Lore Library Key from the floor!
• Return to the Central Main Hall.
• Head up to the Lore Library (North Center Hallway) and press [E] to unlock.

name: Lore Library
description: Grand hall of ancient Angkorian scriptures and historical archives.
guideTitle: LORE LIBRARY PURIFIED: ALL PREPARATORY SEALS BROKEN
guideNarrative: The ancient Angkorian manuscripts illuminate with golden radiance! All 8 preparatory seals are purified. A key has materialized on the library reading desk!
guideNextStep:
• Pick up the Principal's Key from the floor!
• Return to the Central Main Hall.
• Head to the Principal's Office (West Wing, Top) and press [E] to confront the Headmaster!

name: Principal's Office
description: The Headmaster's private sanctum where the Master Key is kept.
guideTitle: PRINCIPAL'S SANCTUM PURIFIED: MASTER KEY CLAIMED
guideNarrative: The Headmaster's spirit sheds tears of remorse for trapping everyone in darkness. He releases the curse and the MASTER KEY materializes on the office floor!
guideNextStep:
• Pick up the MASTER KEY from the floor!
• Return to the Central Main Hall and proceed to the South Exit Iron Gates.
• Press [E] to unlock the Grand Gate and ESCAPE TO VICTORY!

name: Central Main Hall
description: The grand central hub connecting all school wings and exit gates.
guideNarrative: The grand corridor echoes with ancestral spirits watching over your trial.
guideNextStep:
• Explore all door entrances along the West and East wings.
• When you obtain the Master Key, open the South Exit Gates to escape!
